## 1. Quick Commands
- Build: `bun run build`
- Test: `bun test`
- Lint: `bun run lint`

## 2. Architectural Blueprint & Conventions
<!-- KNOTGRAPH:ARCHITECTURE:START -->
- **Core Pattern:** Monorepo with Bun, TypeScript, SQLite engine.
- **Data Flow:** AST/Doc Parsers -> Graph Store -> MCP Server -> Agents.
- **Active ADRs:**
  - ADR-001: Local-first SQLite schema with vector support (`sqlite-vec`).
  - ADR-002: Strict provenance metadata on all MCP tool outputs.
<!-- KNOTGRAPH:ARCHITECTURE:END -->

## 3. Core Entities & Blast Radius Hotspots
<!-- KNOTGRAPH:MAP:START -->
| Module | Primary Responsibility | Critical Dependencies |
|---|---|---|
| `/src/mcp` | MCP Server & Tools Implementation | `/src/graph`, `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` |

## 4. Manual Team Rules & Exceptions (Do Not Overwrite)
- Always write tests for new MCP tools in `/tests/mcp/`.
- Avoid adding external NPM dependencies without prior team review.

## 5. PoC Directory Structure
- All Proofs of Concept must be developed in their own subfolder under `./pocs/` (e.g., `./pocs/poc-01-mcp-server/`).
- Never write PoC code directly at the repository root.
- Each PoC folder is isolated and contains its own `package.json`, `src/`, and `README.md`.
